legacy_rows.Eligibility / restrictions: All students can join the Connector Community; individual paid projects prioritise relevant groups
legacy_rows.Delivery / credit / practical activity: Paid student–staff partnerships improve university provision, from modules and technology to student support. Projects range from weeks to an academic year, around study commitments.
legacy_rows.Basis for reach classification: Official recruitment says all Sussex, IDS and BSMS students can join; access to a particular paid role remains selective.
